status: Frozen local selectors; not yet enforced by a training pipeline

temporal_protocol.final_refit: After selecting hyperparameters on validation, refit training+validation years 2010-2017; calibrate on 2018; score 2019 once after freeze. No learned transform may fit 2018/2019 unless it is the explicitly declared calibration map fitted only on 2018.
temporal_protocol.prior_exposure: Existing all-year EDA includes 2019 descriptive inspection; this is not a pristine never-inspected holdout. No model has been selected using these proposed final-test scores.

spatial_protocol.buffer: Exclude development-cell centres less than 20000 m from any reserved test-cell centre
spatial_protocol.temporal_rules: Use same year roles; train/validate/calibrate only spatial_development cells; final score only spatial_test cells in 2019. Do not reuse the fitted all-geography temporal model.
spatial_protocol.history_features: For this strict secondary experiment, exclude all fire_history_* features from both training and testing; otherwise held-out-area labels could enter engineered history features. Fit preprocessing on spatial-development training years only.

eligibility_caveat: Existing grid includes cells added due to historical ignitions. Reservation does not fix that label-dependent study-mask design; report it and conduct a separate label-independent-mask sensitivity study before final claims.
